summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'Six tiers' → 'Eight tiers' copy fix on Landing (/) and Certifications (/certifications). Both pages now render the corrected copy (H1/H2 headlines, paragraphs) and all 8 tier cards with roman numerals I–VIII. Grep confirms no remaining 'six tiers' string in src. BUT — one hardcoded '6' was missed: the stats-pip section on Landing (Landing.jsx L86) still hardcodes 6 for 'Credential tiers'. This is the exact same class of bug the user originally reported and directly contradicts the 'Eight tiers' hero copy shown 20px above it in the same viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: Still hardcodes numeric '6' for the 'Credential tiers' stat pip below the CTA. Displays '6 CREDENTIAL TIERS' 20px below the corrected 'eight tiers' hero copy — visually contradicts the fix and is the SAME class of bug as the original user report. Should be `{CERT_TIERS.length}` for consistency (and while at it the '24 Courses in catalog' hardcoded stat pip on the same row is worth reviewing too since backend now has 24+ courses that could drift).

But the stats-pip block (Landing.jsx L83-101) was NOT touched in the same pass — the very same '6' the user complained about still lives there. This is a classic 'fix one place, miss another' regression. Any tier-count copy audit must include this block.

rca of the issue:
Root cause: the fix (Landing.jsx CERT_TIERS expansion + dynamic numberToWord in the hero paragraph and ladder H2) was correctly applied to the two prose locations that had textual 'Six tiers' copy, but the third location that also encodes tier count — the numeric stats-pip immediately under the CTA — was overlooked because it stores the count as a bare integer '6' rather than as the word 'six'. Reproduction: load / unauthenticated, look 200-300px below the primary CTA buttons — the row of 4 stat pips shows '6 CREDENTIAL TIERS' next to '24 COURSES IN CATALOG'. Mitigation: change Landing.jsx L86 `
6
` to `
{CERT_TIERS.length}
`. To prevent the same class of bug recurring, add a lint rule or a code-review checklist item that flags any bare integer inside marketing copy blocks.
